info.title: Stogas Dashboard API
info.description: Manage organizations, members, API keys, policies, balance, analytics and activity with an access token. Each request acts as the user who created the token.

get.description: An account that never sent a payment or joined an active organization is deleted at expiresAt.

patch.description: Organizations you create or join later start with this name. To change your name in an organization you already belong to, change its settings.

delete.description: The token stops working at once. A token can delete itself.

get.description: Lists events from the last 365 days, newest first.
Returns every matching event with its changes. More than 50,000 matches fail with 503; narrow the time range. Each export is recorded as activity.

get.summary: List grants you can create keys from

allowMemberKeySettings.description: Effective default permission for newly created member-key policies.
Effective default permission for newly created member-key policies.

get.description: Returns the IDs of every grant that matches the filter, for a bulk change.

patch.description: Moving the grant to another folder deletes the keys made from it by members who lose access. deletedKeyIds lists them.

delete.description: Deletes the member keys made from the grant.

post.description: Deletes the member keys made from the grants.
The response contains the secret if you may use the key.

get.description: Returns the IDs of every key that matches the filter, for a bulk change.

post.description: The old secret stops working at once. The response contains the new secret if you may use the key.

put.summary: Set the BYOK credentials of an API key

get.description: Returns the saved policy of one organization, folder, grant, role, member, BYOK credential or key, with every policy that applies with it.

put.description: Replacing the policy needs its current revision. When new delegation rules no longer allow saved policies below this one, the request fails with 409 POLICY_REMOVAL_REQUIRED. Send it again with policyRemovalToken set to policyRemoval.token from that error to remove them.

get.summary: List the Azure deployments of a credential

patch.summary: Choose whether to use an Azure deployment

post.summary: Check a BYOK credential with its provider

get.description: Lists the organizations the token covers, with your roles and capabilities in each. selectedOrganizationId is selectedOrgId when the list includes it, otherwise your personal organization or the first one listed.

post.description: Uses one use of an invite code.

get.description: Counts the requests an export with the same filters would contain, up to one more than rowLimit. The time range is the last 24 hours unless you set from, to or allTime. filter takes the query syntax of the Analytics page.

Returns the matching requests as a CSV, NDJSON or Parquet file of at most 50,000 rows and 64 MiB; a larger selection fails. Each export is recorded as activity. The time range is the last 24 hours unless you set from, to or allTime. filter takes the query syntax of the Analytics page.

Returns totals and a time series for the matching requests, optionally split into groups. The time range is the last 24 hours unless you set from, to or allTime. filter takes the query syntax of the Analytics page.
Lists the matching requests with their provider attempts, usage and cost. The time range is the last 24 hours unless you set from, to or allTime. filter takes the query syntax of the Analytics page.

get.summary: Get the balance and top-up options
get.description: Includes the latest payments and current price estimates for each payment method.

put.description: Receipts created after the change show the new profile.

post.summary: Get the receipt of a payment
post.description: Returns a PDF. The first request creates the receipt from the billing profile at that time, so it needs write access; later requests return the same receipt.
Returns the organization's open invoice for this currency, or creates one.
Returns the organization's deposit address for this coin and network, creating it the first time.

get.description: Lists credited payments, refunds and manual adjustments, newest first. Spending is not included.

post.description: An invite lasts 7 days and has one use unless you set expiresInSeconds or maxUses. Until it expires, each unused use holds a seat.

patch.description: Changing name needs organization management. displayName is your name in this organization.

post.description: Deletes the keys they made from grants and the invites they created. Each removal permanently lowers the seat limit by one.

get.summary: List resources a role can cover
get.description: Lists folders, grants, BYOK credentials or keys by name, for scoping a role.

get.summary: Get the resources of a role

delete.description: Members left without a role get the default role. To delete the default role, name a new one in replacementDefaultRoleId.

post.description: Members left without a role get the default role. To delete the default role, name a new one in replacementDefaultRoleId.

post.summary: Give or take a role from members
post.description: Members left without a role get the default role.

put.description: An empty list gives the member the default role.

delete.description: Deletes the keys you created from its grants. When the last member leaves, the organization and its balance are deleted.

accessToken.description: Send an access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Create one on the **Account** page, or sign in with `stogas login`. The scope `write` needs a token with **Read and write** access, and `all-organizations` a token for **All organizations**.

Policy.title: Stogas policy v1
Policy.description: Structural editor schema for saved resource policies (organization, folder, grant, role, member, credential, key). Scope controls root registration and delegation targets. Save-time validation checks readable fields, including query grammar, IANA time zones, RE2 safety and cross-field limits. Encrypted plugins are validated at execution. The 262144-byte content limit counts decoded plugin plaintext; storage allows bounded base64 overhead. Unknown properties are rejected.
